summary: Tested all 4 changes (backend + UI). 1) Techfest judge review: reject with remarks gives the toast 'Submission rejected · email sent to team lead'. Portal (Team ID TF-TEAM-1) then shows the portal-rejected banner with the remarks. Editing city and saving sets review_status=pending and resubmitted_at. Admin row shows PENDING plus the Resubmitted badge. Approve gives the toast 'email sent', the badge goes away and the portal shows the portal-approved banner. The API returns email_sent=true; portal /my and PATCH responses leave out review_history, reviewed_by and _id. 2) Robotics Shop tab has the 'Address · City' column (line1/line2 plus city, state · pincode, '—' for pickup orders); the exported XLSX has an 'Address' column between Phone and City. 3) Mongo has no 'vendorplus-4' or 'oll-procure' strings in any listed collection. The only PO vendor_tracking_url is https://vendor-panel-1rt3.vercel.app/track/A76B5C6A and that page returns 200. The /admin/expenses DOM has no old hosts and its PO PDF link goes through the proxy to vendor-panel-6kjc.onrender.com. /shop product images (weserv to onrender /api/files) return 200 webp; 8 images looked unloaded only because they are lazy-loaded below the fold. 4) Support Center: closing a ticket in the middle of the Overdue list (411 cards) kept scrollY the same (9672 before and after), the full-page spinner never appeared (MutationObserver count 0) and the active tab stayed. Closed tickets were reopened.

minor.issue: The permission check is `role not in (admin, super_admin) and not user.get('email')`, so any logged-in user with an email can approve or reject submissions. It should use a real role or permission check (e.g. the 'competitions' permission).
remarks and lead_name (lead_name comes from the user) go into the email HTML without html.escape, which allows HTML injection in emails.
Uses blocking smtplib inside an async handler, which blocks the event loop while email is sent (existing issue). email_sent=true only means no exception was raised.
Business question: editing an APPROVED submission keeps it approved with no re-review, so a team could change its project after approval. Confirm this is intended.

issues: After saving a rejected submission the red banner disappears but nothing replaces it. The toast just says 'Submission updated.' Consider a 'Resubmitted — under review' badge or toast so the team knows it went back to the judges.
Two orders share order_no OLL-SHOP-1787306001 (test data), which gives duplicate data-testid shop-order-address-OLL-SHOP-1787306001.
All 411 overdue cards render with no pagination or virtualization. This is a performance concern, not a regression.

action_items: Tighten the role/permission check on PATCH /api/admin/techfest/submissions/{id}/review
html.escape remarks and lead_name in review_result_html
Optional: show a 'Resubmitted / under review' state on the portal after editing a rejected entry
critical_code_review_comments: techfest.py is 1818 lines and AdminSupportUnified.jsx is 3389 lines; both should be split.

AdminExpenses normalizeVendorUrl regex matches ANY *.preview.emergentagent.com host, not just oll-procure. It is only applied to PO, invoice, logistics and delivery file URLs, so the risk is low, but a file stored on the app's own preview backend would be wrongly rewritten to onrender. Restrict it to oll-procure.

vendor_link_migration runs on every startup and scans whole collections (support_queries 382, school_inquiries 182 docs). Fine now, but it should be filtered with a $regex query or guarded by a one-time flag.
